what.text: This page follows refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 716 refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the United Kingdom, 0.1% of all refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Uganda hosts the most refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, followed by Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in periods from 1996 to 2025, with M23 among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 18 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 6988, at the end of 2007; the main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2011.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
